name: Sherry Shaw
office: Three Valleys Municipal Water District, Member, Board of Directors, Division 3

items.text: Sherry Shaw retired as General Manager and Chief Engineer after 25 years at Walnut Valley Water District. Her short-term priorities include annual budgets, rate adjustments, and increasing communication. She says she would give quarterly presentations at city council meetings on cost-saving programs like free irrigation leak repairs and water conservation. Her campaign says she oversaw $125 million in capital improvement projects, implemented a 4/10 work schedule, and completed new buildings.
